thread:
sophie: Heads-up: small copy refresh for landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). Need final hero lines, a 1-sentence webinar blurb, and Growth routing rules. Keep it short and testable.

marta: Proposed single-line heroes:
Hosted: 'From model to product in minutes.'
Dedicated: 'Reserved capacity for steady performance.'
Private: 'Inference behind your network, with enterprise controls.'

gabe: Bullets under hero (3): 'Smart batching & KV caching', 'Variant routing for graceful fallbacks', 'Per-token telemetry & rollout controls'. Move "Reserved capacity & SLA" to top for Dedicated.

olivia: Webinar blurb: 'Live benchmark: latency, per-token cost, and a quick rollout demo.' Two CTAs to test: 'Reserve spot' vs 'Get benchmark'.

patrick: Growth routing snippet to paste:```if form.interest=="hosted": queue=sdr-hosted
elif form.interest=="dedicated": queue=sdr-dedicated
elif form.interest=="private": queue=sdr-enterprise
if utm_campaign contains "webinar": tag=webinar
hidden: benchmark_pdf_opt_in=true
if interest=="private" and company_size>=500: flag=needs-compliance-review```

ken: APAC note: avoid numeric latency in hero. Also capture primary_use_case (chat, embeddings, search).

sophie: Thanks — I'll assemble a PR with the three hero slabs, bullets, webinar blurb, and routing. Tagging for review before merge. :thumbsup:
